description: Defines classes and enums for managing shared memory audio buffers, including the ShmBuffer and RxBuffer classes, as well as related status enums and callback types.

classes.name: ShmBuffer
classes.description: Manages a shared memory buffer for audio data, providing methods to send status and access buffer data.

classes.name: RxBuffer
classes.description: Derived from ShmBuffer, represents a writable receive buffer for audio data.

methods.name: ShmBuffer(const virtio_snd_pcm_xfer&, volatile uint8_t*, uint32_t, OnConsumedCb)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the buffer with header info, buffer pointer, length, and callback.

methods.name: ShmBuffer(ShmBuffer&&)
methods.description: Move constructor for transferring ownership of the buffer.

methods.name: ~ShmBuffer
methods.description: Destructor, likely handles cleanup and status reporting.

methods.name: stream_id()
methods.description: Returns the stream ID associated with the buffer.

methods.name: len()
methods.description: Returns the length of the buffer.

methods.name: SendStatus(AudioStatus, uint32_t, uint32_t)
methods.description: Sends a status update for the buffer, including latency and consumed length.

methods.name: get() const
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the buffer data.

methods.name: get()
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the buffer data (writable in RxBuffer).
